correctness.rationale: Source arxiv:2608.30601v1 §4 rigorously supplies the two-sphere homotopy and exact forbidden-pair description. The new proof counts invariant simplices as independent sets of edge-orbits with the correct orientation signs. The first reflection has an isolated spoke orbit, forcing trace zero. The other has identical-neighborhood false twins and reduces to a chain of triangles; direct alternating-cover cancellation gives trace 0 or ±2. The already-known rotation character determines all other conjugates and rational representations. The package includes an independently constructed exhaustive finite checker, run successfully, which verifies all 2*(2n) dihedral traces for n=4,6,8,10, and structural quotients through n=14. Finite work is corroboration only.

value.rationale: The two dihedral reflection classes are a natural missing part of the symmetry action on homology for canonical Möbius ladders. The result settles the entire even-width rational dihedral character rather than one arbitrary example, detects a nontrivial orientation sign alternating with n mod8 when n=2 mod4, and distinguishes two rational representations sharing the same homology and rotation character. The path-of-triangles reduction is a structural and reusable signed fixed-point method.
